messages:
Neha (Product): Quick sync — Customer A wants go/no-go criteria for their regulated workload pilot. We need a minimal cut that satisfies security + performance asks without blocking sales. What should be in the pilot acceptance checklist?
Liam (Eng-Arch): Core must-haves: policy-based routing templates, a tenant slice that enforces compute quotas, and region-aware affinity with deterministic fallback. Prefer to keep model variants as first-class in the policy.
Jordan (SRE): Ops must-haves: per-tenant P95 latency + error dashboards, traceability (trace IDs in logs), automated canary rollback, and capacity cutover playbook. Also a failure-injection test for the cutover.
Vivian (Solutions): Customer requirements: KMS-backed keying for audit logs, 1yr audit retention, ability to reserve capacity windows, and an SLA we can sign (target 99.9% availability). If KMS/VPC not ready, they may accept a signed attestation and dedicated reservations for the pilot.
Mike (Eng Lead): Proposed MLP (minimal launch plan): 1) Routing templates + API surface; 2) Slice lifecycle (create/modify/quota) and quota enforcement; 3) Basic audit-log ingestion to S3; 4) Canary + fallback. Defer VPC peering/KMS to enterprise add-on (Q4).
Ava (Sales): Sales asks — pricing band for reservations (daily peak windows) and upgrade path to full Private. Customer needs clear delivery dates or they won't commit.
Neha (Product): Acceptance checklist draft: - Console + API for routing templates - Slice creation + quota enforcement - Per-tenant metrics (P50/P95, error rate) exposed in console - Canary rollout + automatic fallback policy - Audit log pipeline (S3 + signed manifest) - Capacity reservation workflow - Runbook + failure injection tests - Contract SLA text draft
Jordan (SRE): Add SLO burn-rate alert thresholds and escalation playbook. Show simulated load test results before pilot.
Liam (Eng-Arch): I'll put up a short RFC tonight for a compact policy DSL and schema validation. Example policy snippet: ```policy { affinity: region("us-east-1"); primary_variant: "llama-v2-q4f16"; fallback: ["gptq-medium","cpu-fallback"]; max_tail_latency_ms: 300 }```
Vivian (Solutions): For the reservation workflow, we should expose expected capacity (vGPU-hours) and a simple SLA credit calc. Sales can include this in the quote.
Sam (Customer A): Pilot OK for us if reservations and audit pipeline are in place. We'll run in us-east for 2 weeks and validate metrics. Need a contact for incident drills.
Neha (Product): Decisions: - Ship MLP as Mike proposed (routing+slice+audit+canary) - Expose reservation UI + signed audit manifest for pilot - KMS/VPC deprioritized to Q4 enterprise track. Action items: Liam -> RFC (EOD), Jordan -> SRE checklist + load test plan (tomorrow), Mike -> MLP scope PR (Mon), Vivian/Ava -> draft pilot contract language (Mon). rollout-bot: Created epic 'pilot-slice-cutover' targeted for Q3-beta.
Neha (Product): Thanks team — I'll update roadmap doc and ping legal for SLA draft. :raised_hands:
